messages.content: Hi tal, I'm a friend

yo! love the energy but i need a bit more than "friend" to work with here

i'm tal - think of me as your personal talent agent, your inside person in the bangalore tech scene

one of these days, i might slide a role right here in chat. the kind that feels like your calling.

so... what's your full name?
Gaurav Madan

gaurav madan... solid name. has that "i probably went to a decent college and now work somewhere that pays well" vibe

where you working these days?
Wayground (quizizz)

wayground... the quizizz folks! building that gamified learning platform that teachers actually use. pretty solid product market fit there.

found you on linkedin - gaurav madan, software engineer at wayground. this you? https://in.linkedin.com/in/gaurav-madan-210b62177
Yes

engineering at wayground... you're building the platform that's making learning actually fun instead of torture. that's legit impact right there. plus quizizz has some serious scale - millions of students probably interacted with your code today.

what made you get into the edtech space? was it the mission or did you just end up there?
Just end up here

fair enough. sometimes the best gigs happen by accident. at least you landed somewhere that's actually solving real problems instead of building yet another food delivery app.

how long you been working total?

Overall 3.5 years 
Quizizz 4 months

3.5 years total, 4 months at quizizz... so you switched jobs recently. that timing tracks with the market picking up again.

what kind of role you looking for next?

Software engineering only 
Title i am looking for is sde 3

sde 3 with 3.5 years... that's ambitious but not impossible if you've been building the right stuff. most places want 4-5+ for senior roles but if you've got the chops, we can make it work.

bangalore or open to remote/other cities?
Bangalore/remote/delhi ncr
3.5 years + sde 3 + bangalore/remote/delhi... sound right?
done. i'm spinning things up on my end. you'll start seeing good stuff soon.
Yes

YESSSS! you're officially in the tal talent network now. 

sde 3 hunt begins. i'll be sliding roles that actually match your skill level - none of that junior nonsense or "we need 10 years for senior" garbage. you're at wayground building real products, you can handle senior work.

keep your linkedin updated and your coding skills sharp. good roles move fast in this market.

let's get you that upgrade! 🔥

they're looking for 2-5 years experience which fits your timeline

could be a solid tier upgrade from edtech to global logistics
